name: code-ferret
description: Diff-scoped semantic code review: bug hunting across logic, security, concurrency, performance, and API-contract vectors.
long_description: CodeFerret reviews git diffs — never whole repositories — across five detection vectors (LOGIC, SECURITY, CONCURRENCY, PERFORMANCE, API) with confidence scoring, linter deduplication, a false-positive suppression cache, and a secret scanner. The host model performs the semantic analysis, so it works with any frontier model. Use the bundled 'review', 'precommit', and 'triage' prompts to drive it.

tools.name: ferret_collect_context
tools.description: Scoped diff, changed files, history, config, and guidelines for a diff target

tools.name: ferret_run_analyzers
tools.description: Run installed linters/type-checkers/security analyzers with bounded time

tools.name: ferret_scan_secrets
tools.description: Scan added diff lines for credentials

tools.name: ferret_fp_cache
tools.description: Check, add, or list false-positive suppressions

tools.name: ferret_methodology
tools.description: Full CodeFerret review methodology and output schema
